from pathlib import Path
import os,stat,hashlib,json,base64
stage=Path("/workspace/scratch/c714f5bce554/narrow-waitread-controls-20261117")
scope=Path("/workspace/scratch/c714-waitread-20261117")
assert str(stage.parent.resolve())=="/workspace/scratch/c714f5bce554"
assert not os.path.lexists(scope)
os.mkdir(stage,0o755)
os.chmod(stage,0o755)
p=Path("/workspace/scratch/c714f5bce554/narrow-waitread-controls-20261117/waitread-supervisor.cjs")
data=base64.b64decode("",validate=True)
assert len(data)==25389
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()=="da237b7e53a07e47c1625b9b577514a62498fe4816bfa5966c461e5ef4117c9c"
fd=os.open(p,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o644)

        written=os.write(fd,data[offset:])

        offset+=written
    os.fsync(fd)
